# Built-in images without a conformance reference. Read by golden_test.go
# and by javagen/ErrGolden.java, which writes golden/<case>.svg and
# golden/imagedata.txt from the upstream jar.
#
#   case <name>               starts a case, which "end" closes
#   kind <kind>               error (PSystemErrorV2), preprocerror
#                             (PSystemErrorPreprocessor: no raw source, the
#                             message on the last trace line), unsupported
#                             (PSystemUnsupported), welcome (PSystemWelcome
#                             at BACKGROUND_CORNER_BOTTOM_RIGHT) or novalid
#                             (SourceStringReader.noValidStartFound)
#   option <opt>              dark (dark mode color mapper), red
#                             (useRedForError), nometadata
#   line <text>               a source line, located in "string" (or in the
#                             current include) at the next position
#   repeat <n> <text>         n source lines, %d replaced by 1..n
#   include <desc> <index>    the next lines are located in <desc> from
#                             position 0, included from source line <index>
#                             (0-based); "endinclude" goes back to "string"
#   raw <text>                a raw line (by default the raw lines are the
#                             source lines); "noraw" means none
#   trace <n>                 the trace is the first n lines (default: all)
#   error <message>           the error message
#   assumed <TYPE>            the assumed diagram type (DiagramType name)
#
# In texts, \t is a tab, \\ a backslash and \uXXXX a UTF-16 unit.

case novalid
kind novalid
end

case novalid-red
kind novalid
option red
end

case novalid-dark
kind novalid
option dark
end

case novalid-nometadata
kind novalid
option nometadata
end

case error-dark
kind error
option dark
line @startuml
line Alice -> Bob : hi
line Alice -> -> Bob
line @enduml
trace 3
error Syntax Error?
assumed SEQUENCE
end

case error-nometadata
kind error
option nometadata
line @startuml
line Alice -> Bob : hi
line Alice -> -> Bob
line @enduml
trace 3
error Syntax Error?
assumed SEQUENCE
end

case error-five-lines
kind error
line @startuml
line Alice -> Bob : hi
line Bob -> Alice : ok
line Alice -> -> Bob
line @enduml
trace 4
error Syntax Error?
assumed SEQUENCE
end

case error-assumed-class
kind error
line @startuml
line class A
line class B {
line A -->> B
line }
line @enduml
trace 4
error Syntax Error?
assumed CLASS
end

case error-trace-40
kind error
line @startuml
repeat 38 Alice -> Bob : message %d
line Alice -> -> Bob
line @enduml
trace 40
error Syntax Error?
assumed SEQUENCE
end

case error-trace-41
kind error
line @startuml
repeat 39 Alice -> Bob : message %d
line Alice -> -> Bob
line @enduml
trace 41
error Syntax Error?
assumed SEQUENCE
end

case error-trace-60
kind error
line @startuml
repeat 58 participant P%d
line Alice -> -> Bob
repeat 3 Bob -> Alice : after %d
line @enduml
trace 60
error Syntax Error?
assumed SEQUENCE
end

case error-long-lines
kind error
line @startuml
line Alice -> Bob : 0123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012
line Alice -> Bob : 01234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123
line Alice -> Bob : ééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééé
line Alice -> -> Bob : 012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789
line @enduml
trace 5
error Syntax Error?
assumed SEQUENCE
end

case error-include
kind error
line @startuml
line !include a.iuml
include a.iuml 1
line Alice -> Bob : from a
line !include b.iuml
include b.iuml 3
line Bob -> Alice : from b
line Bob -> -> Alice
endinclude
line @enduml
trace 6
error Syntax Error?
assumed SEQUENCE
end

case error-special-chars
kind error
line @startuml
line Alice -> Bob : <b>bold</b> & "quoted" 'single'
line Alice -> Bob : **creole** //italic// [[link]]
line \tAlice -> Bob : tab
line
line
line Alice -> Bob : 中文 😀 ß
line Alice -> -> Bob <&>
line @enduml
trace 8
error Syntax Error? <b>&amp; "x"
assumed SEQUENCE
end

case error-no-assumed
kind error
line @startuml
line foo
line @enduml
trace 2
error Some error without diagram type
end

case error-raw-differs
kind error
raw @startuml
raw !$a = 1
raw Alice -> Bob : $a
raw Alice -> -> Bob
raw @enduml
line @startuml
line Alice -> Bob : 1
line Alice -> -> Bob
line @enduml
trace 3
error Syntax Error?
assumed SEQUENCE
end

case error-continuation
kind error
line @startuml
line Alice -> Bob : a\\
line b\\
line c
line Alice -> -> Bob
line @enduml
trace 5
error Syntax Error?
assumed SEQUENCE
end

case preprocerror-dark
kind preprocerror
option dark
line @startuml
line !include missing.iuml
error cannot include missing.iuml
end

case preprocerror-long
kind preprocerror
line @startuml
line Alice -> Bob : hi
line Bob -> Alice : ok
line Alice -> Bob : again
line !assert 1 == 2 : "numbers differ"
error Assertion error : numbers differ
end

case unsupported-dark
kind unsupported
option dark
line @startfoo
line x
line @endfoo
end

case unsupported-nometadata
kind unsupported
option nometadata
line @startfoo
line @endfoo
end

case unsupported-special
kind unsupported
line @startxyz <b>bold</b> & "q" **c**
line @endxyz
end

case welcome-dark
kind welcome
option dark
line @startuml
line @enduml
end

case welcome-nometadata
kind welcome
option nometadata
line @startuml
line @enduml
end

case welcome-named
kind welcome
line @startuml(id=foo) name
line @enduml
end
